title: Add release team and repository for data_tamer

body:

comments.author: facontidavide
comments.body:
Hi,

sorry to bother you, but I would really really release the library and this is blocking me.
Should I start using, maybe another release repo, instead of gbp?

comments.author: clalancette
comments.body:
> sorry to bother you, but I would really really release the library and this is blocking me. Should I start using, maybe another release repo, instead of gbp?

Sorry, we are working through this.  We'll get back to you soon.  Again, sorry for the delay.

comments.author: clalancette
comments.body: This needs to go through a naming review first.  Can you please open a source-only PR to https://github.com/ros/rosdistro adding this repository?  Once we have done the naming review, then we can come back here and create the release repository.

comments.author: facontidavide
comments.body:
Sorry for the stupid question, but what is a "source-only PR"?
I usually use **bloom** and I am not sure that I understand what you mean

comments.author: clalancette
comments.body:
> Sorry for the stupid question, but what is a "source-only PR"?

Not a stupid question at all.  https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/39513 is an example of a "source-only" PR; it only adds in a `source` and `doc` entry to the relevant ROS distribution.  Once it is approved and merged there, we can then finish this issue and create the ros2-gbp repository.

comments.author: facontidavide
comments.body: the rosdistro PR was merged... next step :smiley: ?

comments.body: Thanks for your patience here @facontidavide, this change has been deployed!
